sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是百分之九十九隐形。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: This past summer, producer Ellie Gordon-Morschel took a trip to Reno, Nevada.
sentences.zh: 今年夏天，制作人埃莉·戈登-莫尔谢尔去了一趟内华达州里诺市。

sentences.en: Well, the temperature is approximately 150 degrees.
sentences.zh: 嗯，温度大约是华氏150度。

sentences.en: Maybe late July is not the best time for a pasty Canadian to visit Reno.
sentences.zh: 也许七月下旬并不是一个脸色苍白的加拿大人访问里诺的最佳时机。

sentences.en: The downtown sites are best seen after sunset anyway.
sentences.zh: 反正市中心的景点最好在日落之后看。

sentences.en: All that neon, even on the cars.
sentences.zh: 到处都是霓虹灯，连汽车上也有。

sentences.en: Where is it coming from?
sentences.zh: 这些光是从哪来的？

sentences.en: Oh, a car.
sentences.zh: 哦，是一辆车。

sentences.en: But I wasn't actually in Reno for the tricked-out cars or casinos or cocktails.
sentences.zh: 但我去里诺其实不是为了看改装车、赌场或鸡尾酒。

sentences.en: I was there on a run-of-the-mill 99PI mission to find a bridge.
sentences.zh: 我去那里是为了执行一项平平无奇的99PI任务，去找一座桥。

sentences.en: Oh my God, now this is the bridge.
sentences.zh: 我的天哪，这座就是桥。

sentences.en: I still can't get over how high-pitched my voice goes there,
sentences.zh: 我到现在还是无法释怀当时我的声音有多尖，

sentences.en: but this was the Virginia Street Bridge, a bridge I've heard many stories about.
sentences.zh: 但这就是弗吉尼亚街桥，一座我听过很多故事的桥。

sentences.en: And apparently there's a long tradition of women throwing their ring in the river.
sentences.zh: 显然这里有一个悠久的传统，就是女性把戒指扔进河里。

sentences.en: This is Ann Sturm.
sentences.zh: 这位是安·斯特姆。

sentences.en: She grew up in Arlington, Virginia.
sentences.zh: 她在弗吉尼亚州阿灵顿长大。

sentences.en: Her mother, Pat, came to Reno in the 1950s to throw her own wedding ring off this very bridge.
sentences.zh: 她的母亲帕特在20世纪50年代来到里诺，把自己的结婚戒指从这座桥上扔了下去。

sentences.en: Ann's mom was in Reno to get divorced, and she was taking part in what had become
sentences.zh: 安的母亲当时在里诺办理离婚，她正在参与后来成为

sentences.en: a final rite of passage for Reno divorcees.
sentences.zh: 里诺离异女性的最终成人礼的活动。

sentences.en: You'd exit the courthouse with your new divorce decree,
sentences.zh: 你拿着新的离婚判决书走出法院，

sentences.en: head two blocks to the Truckee River,
sentences.zh: 走两个街区来到特拉基河，

sentences.en: and fling your wedding ring off the Virginia Street Bridge.
sentences.zh: 然后把结婚戒指从弗吉尼亚街桥上扔出去。

sentences.en: All to symbolize your start as a newly liberated woman.
sentences.zh: 这一切都象征着你作为重新获得自由的女性的新开始。

sentences.en: She just said the tradition was throwing the ring, and my mother did it too.
sentences.zh: 她只说这个传统就是扔戒指，我母亲也这么做了。

sentences.en: Pat's lawyer was there to witness the whole thing, and he was appalled.
sentences.zh: 帕特的律师当时在现场目睹了这一切，他惊呆了。

sentences.en: He couldn't understand how she could dispose of such a valuable asset,
sentences.zh: 他无法理解她怎么能处理掉这么有价值的资产，

sentences.en: so he literally ran into the river.
sentences.zh: 于是他真的跑进了河里。

sentences.en: He was all dressed up in his suit, and he rolled up his pants and maybe took off his shoes.
sentences.zh: 他穿着西装革履，卷起裤腿，可能还脱掉了鞋子。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: And he walked out into that river, and he found the ring.
sentences.zh: 然后他走进了那条河里，找到了戒指。

sentences.en: And he came back, and he said,
sentences.zh: 他走了回来，说道：

sentences.en: you may need this.
sentences.zh: 你可能还需要这个。

sentences.en: Stories like these were common in Reno because back then, in the mid-20th century,
sentences.zh: 这样的故事在里诺很常见，因为在当时，也就是20世纪中期，

sentences.en: it was internationally known as the divorce capital of the world.
sentences.zh: 它在国际上被称为世界离婚之都。

sentences.en: Reno was the best bet for people who were searching for a legal escape
sentences.zh: 对于那些寻找合法途径

sentences.en: from a marriage gone wrong.
sentences.zh: 摆脱错误婚姻的人来说，里诺是最佳选择。

sentences.en: Reno is a fascinating place to me because I love stories about divorce.
sentences.zh: 里诺对我来说是一个迷人的地方，因为我喜欢关于离婚的故事。

sentences.en: I even had a friend once tell me that I was pro-breakup.
sentences.zh: 甚至曾有个朋友对我说我是个支持分手的人。

sentences.en: She didn't mean it in a negative way.
sentences.zh: 她不是贬义地这么说的。

sentences.en: It was like she was just making an observation about one of my political beliefs.
sentences.zh: 就好像她只是在观察我的一项政治信仰一样。

sentences.en: Here's the thing.
sentences.zh: 事情是这样的。

sentences.en: Both of my parents were divorced when they met, and they never remarried.
sentences.zh: 我的父母在相遇时都离过婚，而且他们再也没有结婚。

sentences.en: So I didn't grow up thinking marriage was particularly important.
sentences.zh: 所以我从小并不觉得婚姻有多么重要。

sentences.en: And at the end of the day, a story about people falling in love is just not as interesting as a story about a divorce.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，关于人们坠入爱河的故事，远不如关于离婚的故事有趣。

sentences.en: But for much of modern history, divorce has been very hard to do.
sentences.zh: 但在现代历史的大部分时间里，离婚是非常困难的。

sentences.en: Especially when the Catholic Church ran the show.
sentences.zh: 特别是当罗马天主教会掌权的时候。

sentences.en: It's a sacred bond.
sentences.zh: 这是一条神圣的纽带。

sentences.en: God has blessed it, and God doesn't want you to separate.
sentences.zh: 上帝祝福了它，上帝不希望你们分开。

sentences.en: This is Rod Phillips.
sentences.zh: 这位是罗德·菲利普斯。

sentences.en: He teaches history at Carleton University in Ottawa and wrote a book on the history of divorce in the Western world.
sentences.zh: 他在渥太华的卡尔顿大学教历史，并写过一本关于西方世界离婚史的书。

sentences.en: Divorce laws have historically been influenced by religious practice.
sentences.zh: 从历史上看，离婚法一直受到宗教实践的影响。

sentences.en: And when early settlers colonized the U.S., they brought a range of divorce customs from Protestant Europe with them.
sentences.zh: 当早期定居者在美洲殖民时，他们带来了新教欧洲的一系列离婚习俗。

sentences.en: Yeah, the early settlers, the Puritans, were Calvinists.
sentences.zh: 对，早期的定居者，也就是清教徒，是加尔文主义者。

sentences.en: You know, Calvin's divorce laws were in place in the Netherlands and in parts of Switzerland, like Geneva, and also in Scotland.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，加尔文的离婚法在荷兰、瑞士的部分地区（如日内瓦）以及苏格兰都曾实行过。

sentences.en: So they all allowed divorce.
sentences.zh: 所以他们都允许离婚。

sentences.en: And when they set up their colonies and established the statutes and the laws, they allowed divorce for two grounds of adultery and desertion.
sentences.zh: 当他们建立殖民地并制定规章法律时，他们允许以通奸和遗弃这两种理由离婚。

sentences.en: But not all the settlers were Puritans, of course.
sentences.zh: 当然，并非所有的定居者都是清教徒。

sentences.en: There were Quakers, Lutherans, Baptists, and also Anglicans who followed the Church of England, which at that time still did not permit divorce.
sentences.zh: 这里有贵格会教徒、路德宗、浸信会，还有遵循英国国教会的圣公会教徒，当时该教会仍然不允许离婚。

sentences.en: After American independence, matters of family law were assigned to each individual state.
sentences.zh: 美国独立后，家庭法事务被交给了各个独立的州。

sentences.en: In other words, a state's government had the right to set the rules for how or even if you could attain a divorce.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，一个州的政府有权制定如何甚至是否能获得离婚的规则。

sentences.en: So divorce laws vary dramatically depending on what state you lived in.
sentences.zh: 因此，离婚法因你居住的州而异。

sentences.en: Some states offered several grounds for divorce, while others were more conservative.
sentences.zh: 一些州提供了多种离婚理由，而另一些州则更为保守。

sentences.en: And then there was New York, which only had one ground.
sentences.zh: 然后就是纽约州，它只有一个理由。

sentences.en: Adultery.
sentences.zh: 通奸。

sentences.en: And you had to prove it.
sentences.zh: 而且你必须证明这一点。

sentences.en: Even if both parties in the marriage wanted out, they would need to literally stage a photo op for evidence.
sentences.zh: 即使婚姻中的双方都想解脱，他们也需要真地策划一场拍照取证。

sentences.en: That's where you have people getting into bed with somebody and having somebody jump in through the window with a camera
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么有人会和某人上床，然后让另一个人带着相机从窗户跳进来

sentences.en: and take a picture of them sitting up in bed, fully clothed.
sentences.zh: 拍下他们坐在床上一丝不苟穿着衣服的照片。

sentences.en: And everything, and this was the evidence, this is all the evidence you needed that adultery had taken place.
sentences.zh: 以及所有这些，这就是证据，这就是你证明发生过通奸所需的所有证据。

sentences.en: So if you lived in one of the matrimonially conservative states like New York
sentences.zh: 所以如果你住在像纽约这样婚姻观念保守的州，

sentences.en: and didn't have the resources to collude with your partner to stage an affair, you were left with one option.
sentences.zh: 又没有资源与伴侣串通来策划一场出轨，你只有一个选择。

sentences.en: Go WeSt.
sentences.zh: 去西部。

sentences.en: The Western states tended to be more progressive in many respects.
sentences.zh: 西部各州在许多方面往往更加进步。

sentences.en: The Western states were newly colonized and didn't have the baggage of traditions.
sentences.zh: 西部各州是新近开发的殖民地，没有传统的包袱。

sentences.en: Just the baggage of colonization.
sentences.zh: 只有殖民带来的包袱。

sentences.en: So they looked around and came up with liberal marriage and divorce laws they felt reflected the times.
sentences.zh: 所以他们环顾四周，制定了他们认为反映了时代精神的宽松婚姻和离婚法。

sentences.en: This is kind of an accepted component of our society here.
sentences.zh: 这是我们这里社会中一种被普遍接受的组成部分。

sentences.en: And if people are going to get divorced anyway, you know, get divorced somewhere,
sentences.zh: 如果人们无论如何都要离婚，你知道的，去某个地方离婚，

sentences.en: then we're going to be a community that embraces that.
sentences.zh: 那么我们将成为一个包容这一现象的社区。

sentences.en: This is Alicia Barber, author and public historian based in Reno, Nevada.
sentences.zh: 这位是艾莉西亚·巴伯，作家兼公众史学家，常驻内华达州里诺市。

sentences.en: She says there were a few things that drew outsiders to Reno from its very founding.
sentences.zh: 她说，从里诺建城之初起，就有几件事吸引着外地人来到这里。

sentences.en: Because of its proximity to gold and silver mines, Reno was selected as a stop on the Central Pacific Railroad in the mid-1800s.
sentences.zh: 由于靠近金矿和银矿，里诺在19世纪中期被选为中央太平洋铁路的一站。

sentences.en: This made the city easy to get to for lots of different types of people.
sentences.zh: 这使得这座城市对许多不同类型的人来说都很容易到达。

sentences.en: So Reno kind of became the center of the whole region and really has been this transportation crossroads ever since.
sentences.zh: 因此，里诺有点像整个地区的中心，事实上从那时起它就一直是这个交通十字路口。

sentences.en: And then also a crossroads of many different people coming here for a lot of different reasons.
sentences.zh: 然后它也是许多不同的人出于许多不同的原因来到这里的十字路口。

sentences.en: But the big thing Reno had going for it was its short residency period.
sentences.zh: 但里诺最大的优势在于其短暂的居住期限制。

sentences.en: Much of the population of Nevada was transient, meaning they would come for short periods of time to take advantage of the mining rush.
sentences.zh: 内华达州的大部分人口都是流动人口，这意味着他们会来很短的一段时间，以利用淘金热谋利。

sentences.en: Nevada lawmakers realized if they lowered the time it took to become a resident,
sentences.zh: 内华达州的立法者意识到，如果他们降低成为居民所需的时间，

sentences.en: they could count this transient population as permanent and use them to gain more power in Congress.
sentences.zh: 他们就可以把这些流动人口算作常住人口，并利用他们来获得国会中更多的权力。

sentences.en: So on the books, you know, by the turn of the century, you could become a state resident in six months, which was pretty quick.
sentences.zh: 所以从法理上讲，你知道的，到世纪之交时，你可以在六个月内成为州居民，这相当快。

sentences.en: That meant people could become residents in a shorter period of time and in turn benefit from all the state's laws, including divorce.
sentences.zh: 这意味着人们可以在更短的时间内成为居民，进而享受该州的所有法律，包括离婚。

sentences.en: A shorter residency period and more liberal grounds for divorce meant that if you're wealthy enough to relocate for six months,
sentences.zh: 更短的居住期和更宽松的离婚理由意味着，如果你有足够的财力搬迁六个月，

sentences.en: it could technically be easier to become a temporary Nevada resident, secure a divorce, and then go home rather than get divorced in your actual home state.
sentences.zh: 从技术上讲，成为内华达州的临时居民、确保离婚并随后回家，可能比在你实际居住的州离婚更容易。

sentences.en: Which, of course, made a lot of conservative politicians and social leaders in other states furious.
sentences.zh: 这当然让其他州的许多保守派政客和社会领袖怒不可遏。

sentences.en: They hated that residents could circumvent their own state laws and tried to ban this loophole.
sentences.zh: 他们讨厌居民规避自己州的法律，并试图取缔这个漏洞。

sentences.en: But in most cases, an out-of-state divorce was protected by the Constitution.
sentences.zh: 但在大多数情况下，外州离婚是受宪法保护的。

sentences.en: And in 1905, a famous young socialite named Laura Corey helped transform Reno from a city where you could technically get a divorce to the place to get a divorce.
sentences.zh: 1905年，一位著名的年轻社交名媛劳拉·科里帮助里诺从一个技术上可以离婚的城市转变为“去那里离婚”的胜地。

sentences.en: She was the wife of a prominent industrialist, William Corey.
sentences.zh: 她是杰出实业家威廉·科里的妻子。

sentences.en: People didn't at first know why she was here, but eventually it became clear that she was here to get a divorce.
sentences.zh: 人们起初不知道她为什么来这里，但最终很明显她是来办离婚的。

sentences.en: Coverage of this divorce was in every major newspaper.
sentences.zh: 各大报纸都对这场离婚进行了报道。

sentences.en: That kind of precipitated then this awareness that Nevada, and Reno in particular, was a place where people could easily arrive on the railroad,
sentences.zh: 这随后引发了一种意识，即内华达州，尤其是里诺，是一个人们可以轻松乘火车抵达、

sentences.en: establish their residency, and get a divorce and go on with their lives.
sentences.zh: 建立居住地、离婚并继续他们生活的地方。

sentences.en: So this became known as migratory divorce.
sentences.zh: 因此，这被称为候鸟式离婚。

sentences.en: Laura Corey would just be the first in a parade of headline-worthy Reno celebrity divorces.
sentences.zh: 劳拉·科里只是里诺一长串轰动全国的名人离婚潮中的第一个。

sentences.en: Early on, it was a lot of actors from the Hollywood theatrical community,
sentences.zh: 早期，有很多来自好莱坞戏剧界的演员，

sentences.en: Nat C.
sentences.zh: 纳特·C·

sentences.en: Goodwin and Virginia Harned.
sentences.zh: 古德温和弗吉尼亚·哈恩德。

sentences.en: The famous burlesque entertainer Gypsy Rose Lee divorced her third husband here.
sentences.zh: 著名的滑稽戏艺人吉普赛·罗斯·李在这里与她的第三任丈夫离婚。

sentences.en: But then you can also think about socialites, you know, Vanderbilts, Rockefellers.
sentences.zh: 但你也可以想到社交名流，你知道的，范德比尔特家族、洛克菲勒家族。

sentences.en: Three of the children of Franklin and Eleanor Roosevelt got their divorces in Nevada.
sentences.zh: 富兰克林和埃莉诺·罗斯福的三个孩子都是在内华达州办的离婚。

sentences.en: Soon enough, just a reference to Reno became shorthand for divorce.
sentences.zh: 很快，只需提到里诺就成了离婚的代名词。

sentences.en: By 1910, the phrase,
sentences.zh: 到1910年，这句话，

sentences.en: I'm on my way to Reno, or I'm going to Reno, meant in people's minds, I'm going to get a divorce.
sentences.zh: “我在去里诺的路上”或者“我要去里诺”，在人们的心中意味着“我要去离婚”。

sentences.en: There was a popular song in 1910 called I'm on my way to Reno, and it was sung across the country.
sentences.zh: 1910年有一首流行歌曲叫《我在去里诺的路上》，全国各地都在传唱。

sentences.en: My wife and I don't get along, we simply fight and fight.
sentences.zh: 我和妻子合不来，我们只有无休止的争吵。

sentences.en: I married her to win a bet, it really does me right.
sentences.zh: 我娶她是为了赢得一个赌注，这对我真是个报应。

sentences.en: The love she once declared was mine has simply turned to hate.
sentences.zh: 她曾经宣称属于我的爱已经变成了仇恨。

sentences.en: So I've made up my mind to visit old Nevada state.
sentences.zh: 所以我下定决心要去古老的内华达州看看。

sentences.en: I'm on my way to Reno, I'm leaving town today.
sentences.zh: 我在去里诺的路上，我今天就要离开小镇。

sentences.en: Give my regards to all the boys.
sentences.zh: 替我向所有小伙子们问好。

sentences.en: With Nevada's gold and silver mining depleted,
sentences.zh: 随着内华达州的金矿和银矿资源耗尽，

sentences.en: politicians and businessmen in Reno were looking to take advantage of this new industry cropping up around divorce tourism.
sentences.zh: 里诺的政客和商人们正指望利用围绕离婚旅游业兴起的新产业。

sentences.en: Nevada wasn't the only Western state that noticed the economic benefit of luring in divorce seekers.
sentences.zh: 内华达州并不是唯一注意到吸引离婚寻求者带来经济效益的西部州。

sentences.en: Arkansas, Idaho, and Wyoming had all lowered their residency requirements as well.
sentences.zh: 阿肯色州、爱达荷州和怀俄明州也都降低了居住要求。

sentences.en: Sioux Falls, South Dakota was one of the first cities to take advantage of migratory divorce
sentences.zh: 南达科他州的苏瀑是最早利用候鸟式离婚的城市之一，

sentences.en: and was actually known as a divorce colony.
sentences.zh: 甚至被称为离婚殖民地。

sentences.en: But when the stock market crashed in 1929,
sentences.zh: 但当1929年股市崩盘时，

sentences.en: there were rumors that Idaho and Arkansas were going to match Nevada's residency requirement,
sentences.zh: 有传言称爱达荷州和阿肯色州将匹配内华达州的居住要求，

sentences.en: which had actually been lowered to three months by then.
sentences.zh: 当时内华达州的居住要求实际上已经降至三个月。

sentences.en: The country was entering the Depression and Reno business leaders were desperate to hold tight
sentences.zh: 全国正步入大萧条，里诺的商界领袖拼命想要死死抓住

sentences.en: to the one industry that remained in steady demand.
sentences.zh: 这个需求依然稳定的唯一行业。

sentences.en: And so in 1931, Nevada passed legislation that solidified Reno once and for all
sentences.zh: 因此在1931年，内华达州通过了一项立法，彻底巩固了里诺作为

sentences.en: as the divorce capital of the world.
sentences.zh: 世界离婚之都的地位。

sentences.en: The state legislature reduced that residency period from six months to three months in 1927
sentences.zh: 州议会在1927年将居住期从六个月缩短至三个月，

sentences.en: and then to six weeks in 1931.
sentences.zh: 然后在1931年缩短至六周。

sentences.en: With just six weeks needed to establish residency,
sentences.zh: 只需要六周就能建立居住权，

sentences.en: Reno, Nevada offered the quickest and easiest path to achieving a divorce in the country.
sentences.zh: 内华达州里诺市提供了全国最快、最简单的离婚途径。

sentences.en: This quick and easy pathway expanded access to divorce not just for the rich and famous,
sentences.zh: 这种快捷简便的途径不仅扩大了富豪名流获取离婚的渠道，

sentences.en: but everyday people who didn't have the luxury to take months away from their busy lives.
sentences.zh: 也让那些没有闲暇从繁忙生活中分出几个月时间的普通人受益。

sentences.en: In the same legislative session that lowered Reno's residency to an unheard of six weeks,
sentences.zh: 在将里诺的居住期缩短至闻所未闻的六周的同一届立法会议上，

sentences.en: the state of Nevada also legalized wide open gambling.
sentences.zh: 内华达州还合法化了完全公开的赌博。

sentences.en: With the offer of a quickie divorce, along with a side of cards, slots and dice,
sentences.zh: 凭借闪电离婚的承诺，外加纸牌、老虎机和骰子，

sentences.en: Reno became an unbeatable destination for divorced tourists.
sentences.zh: 里诺成为了离婚游客无法抗拒的目的地。

sentences.en: People talked about you could sit at the main train station in Reno and you could watch the
sentences.zh: 人们常说，你可以坐在里诺的主火车站，看着

sentences.en: tide come in and the untied go out.
sentences.zh: 成双成对的人涌进来，而恢复单身的人走出去。

sentences.en: It was mostly women that came for the Reno divorce and researchers offer a few explanations for this.
sentences.zh: 来里诺离婚的大多是女性，研究人员对此给出了一些解释。

sentences.en: One is that in middle class marriages at the time,
sentences.zh: 其中之一是，在当时的中产阶级婚姻中，

sentences.en: the wife would be less likely to work outside the home and therefore have the time to spend out of state.
sentences.zh: 妻子不太可能在户外工作，因此有时间在州外度过。

sentences.en: Divorce was also technically a type of lawsuit in which one partner had to sue the other to get out of the marriage.
sentences.zh: 从技术上讲，离婚也是一种诉讼，其中一方必须起诉另一方才能摆脱婚姻。

sentences.en: So it was seen as chivalrous for the husband to let his wife sue him for divorce because that way he wouldn't besmirch her reputation.
sentences.zh: 当时人们认为，丈夫让妻子起诉自己离婚是一种绅士风度，因为这样就不会玷污妻子的名声。

sentences.en: It was a lawsuit.
sentences.zh: 那是一场诉讼。

sentences.en: You know, one person had to sue the other on grounds.
sentences.zh: 你知道，一方必须以某种理由起诉另一方。

sentences.en: You had to have a basis for suing to divorce someone.
sentences.zh: 你必须有起诉离婚的依据。

sentences.en: Unlike New York, which just had one single legal ground for divorce, Nevada had seven.
sentences.zh: 与纽约州只有一个单一的法定离婚理由不同，内华达州有七个。

sentences.en: And they ranged from adultery to things like desertion, you know, imprisonment, later abandonment, impotency.
sentences.zh: 范围从通奸到遗弃、监禁、后来的抛弃以及性无能等。

sentences.en: But also one was extreme cruelty.
sentences.zh: 但其中还有一个是极端残忍。

sentences.en: Cruelty was by far the most used ground for divorce in Reno.
sentences.zh: 残忍是雷诺市迄今为止最常用的离婚理由。

sentences.en: And it was an open secret that it could be used as a catch-all for all sorts of grievances.
sentences.zh: 而且这是一个公开的秘密，它可以用作各种不满的“万能借口”。

sentences.en: You didn't need corroborating evidence to prove mental cruelty.
sentences.zh: 你不需要确凿的证据来证明精神虐待。

sentences.en: One husband claimed cruelty by his wife because she criticized his driving.
sentences.zh: 一位丈夫声称妻子对他残忍，因为她批评他的驾驶技术。

sentences.en: Another said his wife accused him of being a German spy.
sentences.zh: 另一位说他的妻子指控他是德国间谍。

sentences.en: Another simply claimed cruelty because her husband made her life dull.
sentences.zh: 还有一位仅仅因为丈夫让她的生活变得乏味而声称受到残忍对待。

sentences.en: Valid reason for a divorce, in my opinion.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，这是离婚的正当理由。

sentences.en: One of the stories was that people were camping along the Truckee River because it was summer, so it would be nice to do that.
sentences.zh: 其中一个故事是，人们因为是夏天，所以沿着特拉基河露营，觉得那样做会很不错。

sentences.en: And they were just camping out for their six weeks.
sentences.zh: 他们就在那里露营度过六周。

sentences.en: This is Mella Rothwell Harmon.
sentences.zh: 这是梅拉·罗斯韦尔·哈蒙。

sentences.en: Mella wrote her master's thesis on the history of the divorce trade in Reno during the Great Depression.
sentences.zh: 梅拉的硕士论文写的是大萧条时期雷诺市离婚贸易的历史。

sentences.en: She says that since most divorce seekers didn't want to rough it outdoors for six weeks straight,
sentences.zh: 她说，由于大多数寻求离婚的人不想在户外连续六周过艰苦的生活，

sentences.en: locals improvised to cater to this influx of temporary residents.
sentences.zh: 当地人便即兴发挥，以满足这些临时居民的需求。

sentences.en: Even though it was a depression,
sentences.zh: 尽管当时处于大萧条时期，

sentences.en: there was a spike in building permits as people were rushing to build apartment houses and add on to their private homes to turn them into boarding houses and converting their garages to little cottages on their property to rent it out.
sentences.zh: 建筑许可却激增，因为人们争相建造公寓楼，扩建私人住宅将其变成寄宿公寓，并将车库改建成出租的小屋。

sentences.en: Where you stayed in Reno and who saw you there were very important pieces of information because you needed to provide both under oath.
sentences.zh: 你在雷诺住在哪里以及谁见过你，是非常重要的信息，因为你需要宣誓提供这两项内容。

sentences.en: You'd give your address and then you'd have someone with you in court who would testify on your behalf,
sentences.zh: 你会提供你的地址，然后带上一个人在法庭上为你作证，

sentences.en: called the resident witness, who would testify that you had been observed in Nevada every day for the six weeks.
sentences.zh: 这被称为“居住证人”，他会证明你在六周内每天都被观察到在内华达州。

sentences.en: Many guest house managers even offered to act as this so-called resident witness as part of a divorce-seeking package deal.
sentences.zh: 许多招待所经理甚至主动提出担任这种所谓的“居住证人”，作为离婚套餐的一部分。

sentences.en: Kind of like, come stay at my accommodations and I'll testify that I saw you every single day for six weeks.
sentences.zh: 就像是，来住我的旅馆，我就作证说我六周里每天都见到你。

sentences.en: One divorce-seeking woman initially lied under oath, claiming that she had stayed in Reno for the required six weeks, when in truth, it had only been four.
sentences.zh: 一位寻求离婚的女性最初在宣誓后撒谎，声称她在雷诺住了要求的六周，而实际上只有四周。

sentences.en: She was sent to jail for committing perjury, but by the end of her sentence, she had incontrovertible proof that she was in Reno the whole six weeks.
sentences.zh: 她因作伪证被送进监狱，但在刑期结束时，她有了无可辩驳的证据，证明她在雷诺待满了六周。

sentences.en: Her resident witness turned out to be none other than the county deputy.
sentences.zh: 她的居住证人竟然就是县里的副警长。

sentences.en: I feel for this divorce-seeking jailbird for many reasons, but one is that she was denied the emotional support, which often came from the women who ran the boarding houses.
sentences.zh: 我出于多种原因同情这位寻求离婚的“囚犯”，但其中之一是她被剥夺了情感支持，而这种支持往往来自经营寄宿公寓的女性。

sentences.en: They were taken in by the boarding house manager, oftentimes like a house mother, and cared for.
sentences.zh: 她们被寄宿公寓经理收留，就像被“房东妈妈”一样照顾。

sentences.en: And many people have written some really lovely comments about how important these people were.
sentences.zh: 许多人写下了一些非常可爱的评论，谈到这些人有多么重要。

sentences.en: I read some of these guest book comments from the 1930s, and they were so intimate, full of inside jokes and intense gratitude, like, quote,
sentences.zh: 我读了一些20世纪30年代的留言簿评论，它们非常亲密，充满了内部笑话和强烈的感激之情，比如，引用：

sentences.en: You took my tears away over my divorce.
sentences.zh: 你带走了我因离婚而流下的泪水。

sentences.en: Gave me a reason to think the future could be happy.
sentences.zh: 给了我一个理由去相信未来会是幸福的。

sentences.en: Well, mom used to try and console these ladies.
sentences.zh: 嗯，妈妈过去常试着安慰这些女士。

sentences.en: This is Jolie Fuch-Pahanek.
sentences.zh: 这是朱莉·福奇-帕哈内克。

sentences.en: It was her family's guest book I read.
sentences.zh: 我读的就是她家的留言簿。

sentences.en: Her grandmother and then-mother ran a beautiful divorce guest house overlooking the Truckee River.
sentences.zh: 她的祖母和当时的母亲经营着一家俯瞰特拉基河的美丽离婚招待所。

sentences.en: Sometimes they'd be up late at night with them, just trying to console them.
sentences.zh: 有时她们会陪她们到深夜，只是为了安慰她们。

sentences.en: And I think they were grateful because she had this upbeat personality and was so outgoing and humorous.
sentences.zh: 我想她们很感激，因为她性格开朗，非常外向且幽默。

sentences.en: It was a delight to have that because otherwise it could be a pretty somber household.
sentences.zh: 能有这样的氛围真是太好了，否则家里可能会显得相当阴郁。

sentences.en: When Anne Sturm's mother came to Reno, she had to travel alone and leave her young children for six weeks,
sentences.zh: 当安妮·斯特姆的母亲来到雷诺时，她不得不独自旅行，并将年幼的孩子留下六周，

sentences.en: all for a divorce she didn't want in the first place.
sentences.zh: 这一切都是为了一个她最初并不想要的离婚。

sentences.en: I had heard my father and mother fighting, arguing, but I'd get in bed with my brother and cry.
sentences.zh: 我听过父母吵架、争论，但我会钻进被窝和哥哥一起哭。

sentences.en: So that was a very clear memory.
sentences.zh: 所以那是一个非常清晰的记忆。

sentences.en: So I knew she was sleeping, and I knew that she had to go to Reno and that she would be gone six weeks.
sentences.zh: 所以我知道她在睡觉，我知道她必须去雷诺，而且她会离开六周。

sentences.en: It could have been a depressing and isolating time for Anne's mom.
sentences.zh: 这对安妮的母亲来说可能是一段令人沮丧和孤立的时光。

sentences.en: But luckily, she had the means to stay at a luxurious dude ranch catered specifically to divorced women.
sentences.zh: 但幸运的是，她有经济能力住在专门为离婚女性提供服务的豪华度假牧场。

sentences.en: It even had individual stalls for nude sunbathing.
sentences.zh: 那里甚至有供裸体日光浴的独立隔间。

sentences.en: My mother was a big sun lover.
sentences.zh: 我母亲是个非常热爱阳光的人。

sentences.en: She came home with a no marks suntan.
sentences.zh: 她回家时晒出了一身毫无痕迹的古铜色皮肤。

sentences.en: There are some really fun old photos of all the divorce-seeking women that stayed at these dude ranches,
sentences.zh: 有一些非常有趣的老照片，记录了住在这些度假牧场的离婚女性，

sentences.en: wearing cowboy outfits, eating dinners together, and horseback riding.
sentences.zh: 她们穿着牛仔装，一起吃晚餐，骑马。

sentences.en: So she went there, and I guess it was full of lots of other women.
sentences.zh: 所以她去了那里，我想那里住满了许多其他女性。

sentences.en: They're going through the same thing.
sentences.zh: 她们正在经历同样的事情。

sentences.en: And obviously, she came home much happier than when she went because of all that therapy.
sentences.zh: 显然，因为那些“治疗”，她回家时比去的时候快乐多了。

sentences.en: You know, it wasn't formal therapy.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那不是正式的治疗。

sentences.en: It was group therapy just because all of these women were in the same boat.
sentences.zh: 那只是群体治疗，因为这些女性都处于同样的境地。

sentences.en: Something else that set Reno apart from other divorce tourism destinations was that it wasn't only accessible to rich white women.
sentences.zh: 雷诺区别于其他离婚旅游目的地的另一点是，它不仅对富有的白人女性开放。

sentences.en: One 1950 feature article in Ebony magazine reported that about 500 Black women came to Reno to divorce each year.
sentences.zh: 《乌木》杂志1950年的一篇专题文章报道称，每年约有500名黑人女性来到雷诺离婚。

sentences.en: These women needed to rely on Reno's local Black community for support, which at that time was very small.
sentences.zh: 这些女性需要依靠雷诺当地的黑人社区来获得支持，而当时该社区非常小。

sentences.en: We also had a community that was very strong because it was so small, and they couldn't do certain things in Reno.
sentences.zh: 我们也拥有一个非常强大的社区，因为它很小，而且她们在雷诺无法做某些事情。

sentences.en: This is Shane Del Cohen.
sentences.zh: 这是谢恩·德尔·科恩。

sentences.en: She's a former board member of Our Story, Inc., which is a nonprofit devoted to stories that have been underrepresented in northern Nevada history.
sentences.zh: 她是“我们的故事”公司的前董事会成员，这是一个致力于讲述内华达州北部历史上被忽视的故事的非营利组织。

sentences.en: She says Black women coming into town for a divorce needed a support system that operated outside of the white mainstream.
sentences.zh: 她说，来到城里离婚的黑人女性需要一个在白人主流社会之外运作的支持系统。

sentences.en: Although by the mid-1900s, many discriminatory laws were overturned in the state,
sentences.zh: 尽管到20世纪中叶，该州的许多歧视性法律已被推翻，

sentences.en: there was still extensive discrimination in Reno.
sentences.zh: 但雷诺仍存在广泛的歧视。

sentences.en: Nevada earned the nickname Mississippi of the West for having overtly racist and exclusionary practices.
sentences.zh: 内华达州因其公开的种族主义和排斥行为而获得了“西部密西西比”的绰号。

sentences.en: So if you were a Black divorce seeker, it was essential to have local support to help navigate the city safely.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你是一名黑人离婚寻求者，拥有当地的支持以帮助安全地在城市中穿行至关重要。

sentences.en: This support was made possible by a small but tightly knit community held together by the local African Methodist Episcopal Church.
sentences.zh: 这种支持是由一个由当地非洲卫理公会圣公会教堂维系的小而紧密的社区实现的。

sentences.en: The social life at that time was centered around the AME Church on Bell Street.
sentences.zh: 当时的社交生活集中在贝尔街的AME教堂周围。

sentences.en: Which had a boarding house right next to it.
sentences.zh: 教堂旁边就有一家寄宿公寓。

sentences.en: And the church had chicken dinners for $1.50 once a month.
sentences.zh: 教堂每月一次提供1.5美元的炸鸡晚餐。

sentences.en: They had a book club.
sentences.zh: 他们有一个读书俱乐部。

sentences.en: They had a little theatrical group.
sentences.zh: 他们有一个小型戏剧小组。

sentences.en: They did all sorts of things.
sentences.zh: 他们做了各种各样的事情。

sentences.en: That same 1950 article in Ebony Magazine features a photo of Reverend Thompson of the Bethel AME who welcomes strangers with this question.
sentences.zh: 《乌木》杂志1950年的那篇文章中有一张伯特利AME教堂汤普森牧师的照片，他用这个问题欢迎陌生人。

sentences.en: Are you here for the cure?
sentences.zh: 你是来寻求“治愈”的吗？

sentences.en: The cure, Reverend Thompson was referring to, is the six weeks cure.
sentences.zh: 汤普森牧师所说的“治愈”，就是“六周治愈”。

sentences.en: A nickname referring to the six weeks it took to get a divorce in Reno and therefore be cured from your miserable marriage.
sentences.zh: 这是一个绰号，指的是在雷诺离婚所需的六周时间，从而从痛苦的婚姻中解脱出来。

sentences.en: I have to say, I was initially confused by how welcoming the church was in an era when divorce was super taboo.
sentences.zh: 我必须说，我最初对在离婚被视为禁忌的时代，教堂竟然如此热情感到困惑。

sentences.en: And so I asked Shane about that.
sentences.zh: 所以我问了谢恩这个问题。

sentences.en: Yes, the church ethic towards marriage and divorce was pretty conservative.
sentences.zh: 是的，教会对婚姻和离婚的伦理相当保守。

sentences.en: But their compassion wasn't.
sentences.zh: 但她们的同情心并非如此。

sentences.en: Their compassion was all-encompassing.
sentences.zh: 她们的同情心是包罗万象的。

sentences.en: But as important as the compassion was, it couldn't pay the bills.
sentences.zh: 但同情心虽然重要，却不能支付账单。

sentences.en: Many of the people who came to Reno also needed money during their six-week stay.
sentences.zh: 许多来到雷诺的人在六周的逗留期间也需要钱。

sentences.en: They needed a job.
sentences.zh: 她们需要一份工作。

sentences.en: A number of the divorce seekers needed to find a job while they were in Reno in order to pay for their divorce and their residency here.
sentences.zh: 许多寻求离婚的人在雷诺期间需要找一份工作，以支付离婚费用和在这里的居住费用。

sentences.en: And there were jobs available for both men and women.
sentences.zh: 而且男女都有工作机会。

sentences.en: Men seeking divorces in Reno could find work as a mechanic or a ranch hand.
sentences.zh: 在雷诺寻求离婚的男性可以找到机械师或牧场工人的工作。

sentences.en: Even famous black Marxist writer C.L.R.
sentences.zh: 甚至著名的黑人马克思主义作家C.L.R.

sentences.en: James got work as a ranch hand while he was in town for a divorce in 1948.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯在1948年因离婚在城里时，也曾做过牧场工人。

sentences.en: If you were a woman, you could head over to the YWCA, which would help set you up with a short-term gig like shop clerk, waitress, housekeeper, or stenographer.
sentences.zh: 如果你是女性，你可以去基督教女青年会（YWCA），她们会帮你安排一份短期工作，比如店员、服务员、管家或速记员。

sentences.en: Or you could find work in one of the many institutions Reno was famous for.
sentences.zh: 或者你可以在雷诺著名的众多机构中找到工作。

sentences.en: Reno's casino industry was both entertainment for the divorce seekers as well as a place for employment.
sentences.zh: 雷诺的赌场业既是离婚寻求者的娱乐场所，也是就业场所。

sentences.en: Before the tourism industry, gambling mostly took place in back rooms and was geared towards a rougher local crowd.
sentences.zh: 在旅游业兴起之前，赌博大多发生在后屋，主要针对当地粗犷的人群。

sentences.en: But with the flood of divorced tourists in town, casino owners were looking for new ways to appeal to these middle-class visitors.
sentences.zh: 但随着离婚游客涌入城里，赌场老板们正在寻找新的方式来吸引这些中产阶级游客。

sentences.en: There was a very famous club called Harold's Club that opened in the 1930s that started to promote itself through a real kind of cartoony Western kind of theming that made it seem more like respectable fun and not just some kind of sordid activity.
sentences.zh: 20世纪30年代开业的一家非常有名的俱乐部叫“哈罗德俱乐部”，它开始通过一种真正的卡通式西部主题来宣传自己，使其看起来更像是体面的娱乐，而不仅仅是某种肮脏的活动。

sentences.en: Alicia Barber again.
sentences.zh: 又是艾丽西亚·巴伯。

sentences.en: She says one tactic of increasing respectability was hiring women.
sentences.zh: 她说，提高体面度的一个策略是雇佣女性。

sentences.en: And there was one job completely perfect for the Reno intersection of gambling and divorce.
sentences.zh: 而且有一个工作非常适合雷诺赌博与离婚交汇的特点。

sentences.en: The shill.
sentences.zh: “托儿”（Shill）。

sentences.en: There was a job known as a shill, where attractive women would be hired to just sit at one of the table games and play the game and look delighted and, you know,
sentences.zh: 有一种被称为“托儿”的工作，就是雇佣有吸引力的女性坐在赌桌旁玩游戏，看起来很高兴，你知道，

sentences.en: try to attract other people to come.
sentences.zh: 试图吸引其他人过来。

sentences.en: In 2014, Mella Harmon spoke with a woman named Janice, whose mother was hired as a shill when she was out in Reno seeking a divorce in 1944.
sentences.zh: 2014年，梅拉·哈蒙采访了一位名叫珍妮丝的女士，她的母亲在1944年到雷诺寻求离婚时被雇为“托儿”。

sentences.en: When she went up to get her divorce, she had to figure out a way to earn a living because she was going to be there for six weeks.
sentences.zh: 当她去办离婚时，她必须想办法谋生，因为她要在那里待上六周。

sentences.en: And I also think she'd have been bored to tears sitting up there for six weeks trying to find something to do so.
sentences.zh: 而且我也认为，如果让她在那里坐上六周找事做，她会无聊透顶的。

sentences.en: But she was a very good card player.
sentences.zh: 但她是个非常好的纸牌玩家。

sentences.en: And she told me I didn't know they hired shills.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我，我不知道他们还雇佣“托儿”。

sentences.en: But she said she'd sit at the blackjack table.
sentences.zh: 但她说她会坐在二十一点赌桌旁。

sentences.en: There's even a story of a local woman applying for a job at the same casino who recalled that everyone kept asking her, are you sure you're not here for a divorce?
sentences.zh: 甚至有一个故事说，一位当地女性在同一家赌场申请工作时，回忆起每个人都在问她：“你确定你不是来离婚的吗？”

sentences.en: The general impression was that, you know, Reno-ites were pretty amused by it and thought, wow, this is just great, you know.
sentences.zh: 普遍的印象是，你知道，雷诺人对此感到非常有趣，并认为，哇，这真是太棒了，你知道。

sentences.en: So there was a lot of popular culture.
sentences.zh: 所以有很多流行文化。

sentences.en: And then this was the kind of publicity that really fed upon itself.
sentences.zh: 而且这种宣传确实是自我循环的。

sentences.en: So Reno's promoters didn't have to do anything to get this kind of publicity because the media was just fascinated by it.
sentences.zh: 所以雷诺的推广者不需要做任何事情就能获得这种宣传，因为媒体对它太着迷了。

sentences.en: In between juicy newspaper headlines, the American public was fed a steady stream of Reno divorce drama from Hollywood filMs.
sentences.zh: 在劲爆的报纸头条之间，美国公众从好莱坞电影中获得了源源不断的雷诺离婚剧。

sentences.en: Really starting in the 1930s, there were a lot.
sentences.zh: 真正从20世纪30年代开始，数量就很多了。

sentences.en: There were three in production in 1931.
sentences.zh: 1931年就有三部在制作中。

sentences.en: It was just fertile ground for drama.
sentences.zh: 这简直是戏剧的沃土。

sentences.en: Even Marilyn Monroe's last film, The Misfits, was about a Reno divorce.
sentences.zh: 甚至玛丽莲·梦露的最后一部电影《乱点鸳鸯谱》也是关于雷诺离婚的。

sentences.en: In this scene, she stands on the famous Virginia Street Bridge and contemplates throwing her own ring in.
sentences.zh: 在这一幕中，她站在著名的弗吉尼亚街大桥上，考虑把自己的戒指扔进去。

sentences.en: If you throw in your ring, you'll never get another divorce.
sentences.zh: 如果你扔掉戒指，你就永远不会再离婚了。

sentences.en: Honey, everybody does this.
sentences.zh: 亲爱的，每个人都这么做。

sentences.en: More gold in that river than there is in the Klondike.
sentences.zh: 那条河里的金子比克朗代克河里的还多。

sentences.en: The personal stakes were high for all of these women and Reno delivered.
sentences.zh: 对所有这些女性来说，个人利害攸关，而雷诺做到了。

sentences.en: It was a refuge from social taboos, an opportunity for job experience, and a potential pathway to a more fulfilling marriage with financial security.
sentences.zh: 它是逃避社会禁忌的避难所，是获得工作经验的机会，也是通往更充实婚姻和财务保障的潜在途径。

sentences.en: If you manage to wear a cowboy hat, play the slots, and have fun while at it, that was just a bonus.
sentences.zh: 如果你能戴上牛仔帽，玩玩老虎机，并在此过程中玩得开心，那只是额外收获。

sentences.en: Reno's divorce era began petering out in the late 1960s, as divorce law became more liberalized throughout the Western world.
sentences.zh: 雷诺的离婚时代在20世纪60年代末开始逐渐消退，因为离婚法在整个西方世界变得更加自由化。

sentences.en: The migratory divorce industry in Nevada really ended in the 1960s with the introduction of irreconcilable differences and no-fault divorce throughout the country.
sentences.zh: 内华达州的移民离婚产业确实在20世纪60年代随着全国范围内“不可调和的分歧”和“无过错离婚”的引入而结束。

sentences.en: In 1969, California became the first state to introduce irreconcilable differences and no-fault divorce.
sentences.zh: 1969年，加利福尼亚州成为第一个引入“不可调和的分歧”和“无过错离婚”的州。

sentences.en: Previously, one spouse had to sue the other in order to get out of a marriage on specific grounds.
sentences.zh: 在此之前，一方必须起诉另一方才能以特定理由解除婚姻。

sentences.en: Like adultery or being a German spy.
sentences.zh: 比如通奸或成为德国间谍。

sentences.en: But no-fault divorce meant you didn't need to prove wrongdoing anymore.
sentences.zh: 但无过错离婚意味着你不再需要证明不当行为。

sentences.en: Other states quickly followed California's lead and adopted similar divorce laws.
sentences.zh: 其他州很快效仿加州的先例，通过了类似的离婚法。

sentences.en: And that really pretty much put an end to it, because then it wouldn't be any harder to really get a divorce in other places than it was in Nevada.
sentences.zh: 这基本上就结束了这一切，因为那时在其他地方离婚并不比在内华达州更难。

sentences.en: It might be faster in Nevada, but the fact that you didn't have to sue anymore just made it more widely available and efficient throughout the country.
sentences.zh: 在内华达州可能更快，但不再需要起诉这一事实，使其在全国范围内变得更普及、更高效。

sentences.en: Reno held the title of Divorce Capital of the World for a little over six decades and helped bring an end to tens of thousands of marriages.
sentences.zh: 雷诺保持了六十多年的“世界离婚之都”称号，并帮助终结了数以万计的婚姻。

sentences.en: Even though today visitors may not be aware of Reno's divorce history, it altered the identity of the city forever.
sentences.zh: 尽管今天的游客可能不知道雷诺的离婚历史，但它永远改变了这个城市的身份。

sentences.en: It was divorce that really was largely the inspiration for this slogan that we have for Reno, which is the biggest little city in the world.
sentences.zh: 正是离婚在很大程度上激发了我们雷诺的口号，即“世界上最大的小城市”。

sentences.en: That was about the fact that for its size, which was small, modest, little western town, Reno was so much more cosmopolitan than you would expect.
sentences.zh: 这是因为雷诺虽然规模小、谦逊、是个西部小镇，但却比你预期的要国际化得多。

sentences.en: And that, in many ways, was due to the fact that you had all of these people coming from outside to get divorces from much more cosmopolitan urban centers.
sentences.zh: 在许多方面，这是因为你有所有这些从外面来离婚的人，他们来自更国际化的大都市中心。

sentences.en: And they brought something with them.
sentences.zh: 他们带来了一些东西。

sentences.en: And that did stay with Reno.
sentences.zh: 而这确实留在了雷诺。

sentences.en: And that really, in combination then with the legalization of gambling, created the tourism industry that has continued to this day in the state of Nevada.
sentences.zh: 这与赌博合法化相结合，创造了至今仍在内华达州持续的旅游业。

sentences.en: And now, a good 50 years after the end of Reno's reign as the Divorce Capital of the World, I approached the Virginia Street Bridge.
sentences.zh: 现在，在雷诺作为“世界离婚之都”的统治结束50年后，我走近了弗吉尼亚街大桥。

sentences.en: The bridge where women cast off their wedding rings for decades and was shocked by a sight.
sentences.zh: 这座女性几十年来抛弃婚戒的桥，我被眼前的景象惊呆了。

sentences.en: My God, there's love locks here now.
sentences.zh: 天哪，现在这里有爱情锁了。

sentences.en: Ironic!
sentences.zh: 真讽刺！

sentences.en: Love locks.
sentences.zh: 爱情锁。

sentences.en: Like those padlocks you sometimes see on famous bridges.
sentences.zh: 就像你在一些著名桥梁上偶尔能看到的那些挂锁一样。

sentences.en: That thing where a couple inscribes their initials, attaches the lock to the bridge, and then throws away the key, all to symbolize unbreakable love or whatever.
sentences.zh: 就是那种情侣把名字缩写刻在上面，把锁扣在桥上，然后把钥匙扔掉，以此象征坚贞不渝的爱情之类的东西。

sentences.en: Needless to say, I was startled, then annoyed, by this discovery.
sentences.zh: 不用说，我当时先是吃了一惊，然后对这一发现感到厌烦。

sentences.en: This was a bridge of liberation.
sentences.zh: 这本是一座自由之桥。

sentences.en: How dare it be vandalized by relationships literally represented by shackles.
sentences.zh: 怎么能被这些字面上代表着枷锁的感情所破坏呢。

sentences.en: But then, up until recently, I had no idea Reno's famous casinos were employers of unhappily married women.
sentences.zh: 但直到最近，我才知道里诺著名的赌场竟然雇佣了婚姻不幸福的女性。

sentences.en: So maybe I was missing the story behind these locks, too.
sentences.zh: 所以也许我也错过了这些锁背后的故事。

sentences.en: It's about love of yourself.
sentences.zh: 这是关于爱自己。

sentences.en: Maybe these aren't locks dedicated to self-love.
sentences.zh: 也许这些锁并不是为了自爱而设的。

sentences.en: Who am I kidding?
sentences.zh: 我这是在自欺欺人吗？

sentences.en: But at the very least, these couples already know of a fun place to get divorced.
sentences.zh: 但至少，这些情侣已经知道了一个离婚的好去处。

sentences.en: After the break, Ellie comes back to tell me about a different Canadian who visited Reno and wrote a very influential book about it.
sentences.zh: 休息之后，艾莉会回来告诉我另一位去过里诺并写了一本非常有影响力的书的加拿大人。

sentences.en: So we're back with producer Ellie Gordon-Morschel.
sentences.zh: 我们现在回到制作人艾莉·戈登-莫舍尔身边。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for that story, Ellie.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你的故事，艾莉。

sentences.en: It was a fun divorce story.
sentences.zh: 这是一个有趣的离婚故事。

sentences.en: I told you it would be.
sentences.zh: 我告诉过你会很有趣的。

sentences.en: I know, and you delivered.
sentences.zh: 我知道，你没让我失望。

sentences.en: But one thing I did not mention in the story is that I actually brought my girlfriend on my Reno divorce trip.
sentences.zh: 但我在故事中没提到的一点是，我其实是带着女朋友去里诺办离婚之旅的。

sentences.en: That's kind of a strange couple's getaway to do your divorce story with your partner.
sentences.zh: 带着伴侣去完成你的离婚故事，这算是一种奇怪的情侣度假。

sentences.en: Okay, I think it's romantic.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我觉得这很浪漫。

sentences.en: But one of the afternoons we were there, we were trying to find some postcards.
sentences.zh: 但在我们待在那里的一个下午，我们想找些明信片。

sentences.en: First at an actual feminist bookstore slash cat adoption center.
sentences.zh: 先是在一家真正的女权主义书店兼猫咪领养中心。

sentences.en: But it was closed, sadly.
sentences.zh: 但遗憾的是，它关门了。

sentences.en: However, next door, someone had spotted us and kind of was like, oh, why don't you come in here and check things out?
sentences.zh: 然而，隔壁有人发现了我们，就像是说，哦，你们为什么不进来看看呢？

sentences.en: And it turned out that place was the Northern Nevada LGBTQ Center.
sentences.zh: 结果那个地方是北内华达州LGBTQ中心。

sentences.en: Nice.
sentences.zh: 不错。

sentences.en: And so when I told the executive director why we were in town, she was like, oh, come here and take a look at this.
sentences.zh: 当我告诉执行董事我们为什么来这里时，她说，哦，过来看看这个。

sentences.en: And she rolled out a big movie poster.
sentences.zh: 她展开了一张巨大的电影海报。

sentences.en: And on it was a 1950s convertible.
sentences.zh: 上面是一辆1950年代的敞篷车。

sentences.en: There's two women standing in front, one in modest white heels and the other in like cool cowboy boots.
sentences.zh: 前面站着两个女人，一个穿着朴素的白色高跟鞋，另一个穿着很酷的牛仔靴。

sentences.en: And the slogan across the top read, in 1959, Vivian Bell came to Reno for a quickie divorce.
sentences.zh: 顶部的标语写着：1959年，薇薇安·贝尔来到里诺办理速成离婚。

sentences.en: Of all the people she met there, the one that most surprised her was herself.
sentences.zh: 在她遇到的所有人中，最让她感到惊讶的是她自己。

sentences.en: So I recognized it immediately because it's for this film called Desert Hearts,
sentences.zh: 所以我立刻认出了它，因为它是那部叫《沙漠之心》的电影。

sentences.en: which is beloved in the queer community because it was the first mainstream lesbian film to have a happy ending.
sentences.zh: 它在酷儿群体中很受欢迎，因为它是第一部有圆满结局的主流女同性恋电影。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: So what year did this come out?
sentences.zh: 那它是哪一年上映的？

sentences.en: It came out in 1985, which is actually the year I was born.
sentences.zh: 它于1985年上映，那年正好是我出生的年份。

sentences.en: But it was just one of those things and films I just knew about, you know, like out of the lesbian cinematic universe.
sentences.zh: 但这只是我所知道的那些事情和电影之一，你知道的，就像是女同性恋电影宇宙里的东西。

sentences.en: But the film was actually based on a novel that came out in 1964 called Desert of the Heart by an author named Jane Rule.
sentences.zh: 但这部电影实际上是基于1964年出版的一本小说，书名叫《沙漠之心》，作者是简·鲁尔。

sentences.en: Tell me more about Jane Rule.
sentences.zh: 多跟我讲讲简·鲁尔吧。

sentences.en: She was a fellow Canadian and she did pass away in 2007.
sentences.zh: 她也是加拿大人，于2007年去世。

sentences.en: And even though I hadn't heard of her, she was a well-known literary figure in some circles.
sentences.zh: 尽管我之前没听说过她，但她在某些圈子里是一位著名的文学人物。

sentences.en: I would say she was besties with Margaret Atwood.
sentences.zh: 我会说她是玛格丽特·阿特伍德的闺蜜。

sentences.en: It turns out Jane Rule's archives are at the University of British Columbia.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，简·鲁尔的档案存放在不列颠哥伦比亚大学。

sentences.en: And when I was looking through them, I felt like there was like hundreds of letters from Atwood.
sentences.zh: 当我翻阅它们时，感觉里面有几百封阿特伍德的信。

sentences.en: And on a shallow note, I have to say I was pleased to see that Margaret Atwood's handwriting is just as bad as mine.
sentences.zh: 肤浅地说一句，我很高兴看到玛格丽特·阿特伍德的字迹和我的一样烂。

sentences.en: They're just like us.
sentences.zh: 她们和我们一样。

sentences.en: So tell me about Jane's connection to Reno, like what prompted her to write this book.
sentences.zh: 那么告诉我简与里诺的联系，是什么促使她写了这本书。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So I read Desert of the Heart about a year ago.
sentences.zh: 我大约一年前读了《沙漠之心》。

sentences.en: That is how I found out about the Reno divorce history.
sentences.zh: 我就是这样了解到里诺离婚历史的。

sentences.en: That's why this episode exists.
sentences.zh: 这就是这一集存在的原因。

sentences.en: And unlike the movie version, there's just so much detail about the older character coming into town for a Reno divorce.
sentences.zh: 和电影版不同，书里有太多关于那个年长角色来到镇上办理里诺离婚的细节。

sentences.en: And the detail of it made me think like Jane must have gone to Reno, but I just I just could not find that out in the research online.
sentences.zh: 这些细节让我觉得简一定去过里诺，但我只是在网上的研究中找不到这一点。

sentences.en: But then an acquaintance of a friend emailed and was like, I'm pretty sure Jane's long term partner, Helen, went to Reno for a divorce.
sentences.zh: 但后来一个朋友的熟人发邮件说，我很确定简的长期伴侣海伦去过里诺离婚。

sentences.en: And I was like, oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 我当时就想，天哪。

sentences.en: And I was so excited.
sentences.zh: 我太兴奋了。

sentences.en: And that's why I went to the archives in the first place.
sentences.zh: 这就是我当初去档案馆的原因。

sentences.en: And yeah, sure enough, Helen did travel to Reno for a divorce and Jane went with her.
sentences.zh: 没错，海伦确实去了里诺离婚，简也陪她去了。

sentences.en: So the so the book came out in 64.
sentences.zh: 所以书是在64年出版的。

sentences.en: So when when did she experience Reno?
sentences.zh: 那么她是什么时候体验里诺的？

sentences.en: She was there in 1958, which was nearing the end of sort of Reno being the divorce capital.
sentences.zh: 她在1958年就在那里了，那时里诺作为离婚之都的地位已接近尾声。

sentences.en: But I would say it probably still was very much experiencing the heyday of that.
sentences.zh: 但我会说，它可能仍然非常处于那个鼎盛时期。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And Jane had written to her parents that Helen couldn't get a divorce in her home state, Massachusetts, because most of the judges were Catholic.
sentences.zh: 简曾写信给父母说，海伦无法在她家乡马萨诸塞州离婚，因为大多数法官都是天主教徒。

sentences.en: And while they were both in Reno, Jane actually got a job at a casino.
sentences.zh: 当她们都在里诺时，简实际上在一家赌场找到了一份工作。

sentences.en: Oh, was she one of the shills you were talking about?
sentences.zh: 哦，她是你说的那种赌场托儿吗？

sentences.en: She did learn about shills from an employment agency and she did try and get a job as one at the Mapes Casino, which is actually where Desert Hearts was filmed decades later.
sentences.zh: 她确实从职业介绍所了解到了托儿的工作，并试图在梅普斯赌场应聘，而《沙漠之心》几十年后正是在那里拍摄的。

sentences.en: But the manager took one look at her and said, sorry, lady.
sentences.zh: 但经理看了她一眼说，抱歉，女士。

sentences.en: And this is just me guessing.
sentences.zh: 这只是我的猜测。

sentences.en: But I think it's because Jane Rule was a six foot tall lesbian.
sentences.zh: 但我认为是因为简·鲁尔是个六英尺高的女同性恋。

sentences.en: I see.
sentences.zh: 我明白了。

sentences.en: So she wasn't like the typical shill material.
sentences.zh: 所以她不是典型的托儿人选。

sentences.en: No, she was not.
sentences.zh: 不，她不是。

sentences.en: But she did end up getting a job at Harold's Club.
sentences.zh: 但她最终在哈罗德俱乐部找到了一份工作。

sentences.en: And so what did she do for Harold?
sentences.zh: 那她为哈罗德做了什么？

sentences.en: She had this job called Change Girl, which involved lugging around 40 pounds of coins for customers that needed to break their bills for the slots.
sentences.zh: 她做了一份叫“换钱女孩”的工作，负责为需要把钞票换成硬币玩老虎机的顾客搬运40磅重的硬币。

sentences.en: And she wrote an excited letter to her parents about the job and that the experience was probably destined to give her writing material, which of course it was.
sentences.zh: 她给父母写了一封兴奋的信，说这份工作注定会给她提供写作素材，当然确实如此。

sentences.en: And then the bonus of a frontier outfit that she could bring back to Vancouver.
sentences.zh: 还有一套可以带回温哥华的边境风格服装作为额外收获。

sentences.en: OK, so she's down there with Helen.
sentences.zh: 好的，所以她和海伦在那里。

sentences.en: I assume Helen got her divorce.
sentences.zh: 我假设海伦离了婚。

sentences.en: So what happens then?
sentences.zh: 那后来发生了什么？

sentences.en: Yeah, she got her divorce.
sentences.zh: 是的，她离了婚。

sentences.en: Her and Jane went back up to B.C.
sentences.zh: 她和简回到了不列颠哥伦比亚省。

sentences.en: And in one of the letters I saw written, you know, during this time, Jane mentioned her own marital status.
sentences.zh: 在我看到的一封写于那段时间的信中，简提到了她自己的婚姻状况。

sentences.en: She was writing to her parents.
sentences.zh: 她是在给父母回信。

sentences.en: She was responding to what must have been a letter about them being worried that Jane herself would never get married.
sentences.zh: 她是在回应一封信，信中他们一定担心简自己永远不会结婚。

sentences.en: And so Jane was writing them back and said, I haven't the vaguest desire to get married.
sentences.zh: 所以简回信说，我一点结婚的念头都没有。

sentences.en: And then she goes on to say that she doesn't feel too guilty about it because I'm fairly sure that you're rather fond of who I am, which is very sweet.
sentences.zh: 然后她继续说，她对此并不感到太内疚，因为“我很确定你们相当喜欢现在的我”，这非常贴心。

sentences.en: She wrote them a lot.
sentences.zh: 她给他们写了很多信。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's very sweet.
sentences.zh: 是的，非常贴心。

sentences.en: So Helen passes away in 2000, which is before gay marriage is legalized in Canada.
sentences.zh: 海伦于2000年去世，那是在加拿大同性婚姻合法化之前。

sentences.en: But I have to say, like, knowing what I know about Jane rule, I really don't think they would have ever married anyway.
sentences.zh: 但我必须说，根据我对简·鲁尔的了解，我真的认为她们无论如何都不会结婚。

sentences.en: But they stayed together for the rest of their lives and their ashes are at the Galliano Island Cemetery.
sentences.zh: 但她们余生一直在一起，骨灰安葬在加利亚诺岛公墓。

sentences.en: And so where is Galliano Island?
sentences.zh: 那么加利亚诺岛在哪里？

sentences.en: It's actually it's pretty close to Vancouver.
sentences.zh: 它离温哥华很近。

sentences.en: It's part of the Gulf Islands that are just a ferry ride away.
sentences.zh: 它是海湾群岛的一部分，坐渡轮就能到。

sentences.en: OK.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And Roman, I didn't plan this, but my girlfriend and I actually booked a cabin for the weekend right before this episode drops on Galliano Island.
sentences.zh: 罗曼，我没计划过，但我和女朋友确实预订了这一集发布前那个周末在加利亚诺岛的小木屋。

sentences.en: And a couple of days ago, I looked up the cemetery and our cabin is literally steps away.
sentences.zh: 几天前，我查了那个公墓，我们的小木屋离那里真的只有几步之遥。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: That's so cool.
sentences.zh: 太酷了。

sentences.en: So you're going to go and pay your respects.
sentences.zh: 所以你要去表达敬意了。

sentences.en: I definitely will.
sentences.zh: 我一定会去的。

sentences.en: I want to thank Jane for introducing me to Reno.
sentences.zh: 我想感谢简把我带到了里诺。

sentences.en: Well, I'm glad she introduced you to Reno.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我很高兴她把你带到了里诺。

sentences.en: And then I'm glad that you introduced us to Reno.
sentences.zh: 我也很高兴你把我们带到了里诺。

sentences.en: So thanks so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。
